g.text: Isolated percentile: one reducer per memory process
Dots = medians; bars = full min–max of seven fresh processes. Fixed shared inputs, retention counts and explicit GC.
Release includes common serializer/GC pressure; differences are diagnostics, not allocation totals or leak proof. RSS sampling may miss short peaks.
Unrelated Windows activity uncontrolled. All other snapshots and negative/noisy deltas remain in JSON/CSV.
